engine: Godot 4.7.2 stable; 60 fixed simulation ticks per second
roster: All 10 registered heroes represented in every 12-participant match; production stats, kits, AI, physics, navigation, damage and presentation processing remain active.
stall_method: Independent one-second position samples. Flag eight consecutive seconds moving less than 0.65m while alive, ready/reloading, without root/slow/stun statuses, not intentionally holding, and over 2.5m from the expected goal. These rules identify route stalls; other states are outside this detector.
resource_method: Sample engine memory, object, node, orphan, resource and transient counts every minute. Track old arena, actor, controller and non-pooled effect references across actual scene changes. Verify empty-tree counts and capture process stderr through shutdown.
result: All three profiles passed: no runtime errors, shutdown leak diagnostics, eight-second route stalls, falls or recovery teleports. Every final teardown restored the 340-node baseline with zero orphan nodes, live actors, sessions, resolvers, attacks or transients.
limits: Seeded automated coverage does not establish balance, player-control feel, every possible path or every ability edge case. Escort-start drills are staged combat and are reported separately from natural rounds. Remaining cached resource/object counts above a cold baseline are reported; no leaked-node or engine-shutdown diagnostics were observed.
